History_of_Present_Illness.content: A few days history of dry, itchy, red skin mainly on arms and hands that began after swimming and has not improved with coconut butter used for a few days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Few days of dry, itchy, red skin mainly on arms/hands; began after swimming; coconut butter x few days—no relief

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No spots associated with the rash.
Bowel function reported as working okay.
Reports significant work stress related to being a primary school teacher, working long hours, and finding the kids annoying.

Assessment.content: Dermatitis presenting as a pruritic, erythematous, dry rash on hands and arms for a few days, with onset after swimming, no systemic symptoms, and unresponsive to coconut butter.
Assessment.source_text: 1) Dermatitis—pruritic, erythematous, dry rash on hands/arms x few days; onset post-swimming; no systemic sx; unresponsive to coconut butter

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide patient information leaflet on dermatitis.
Prescribe or recommend topical steroid cream.
Use emollients liberally throughout the day.
Use over-the-counter antihistamines such as Piriton or loratadine for itch.
Paracetamol or other analgesics are not indicated.

Follow_up_Information.content: Follow up next week if not improving.
